description.p: This is a fork of the Linux Libertine and Linux Biolinum fonts that started as an OpenType math companion of the Libertine font family, but grown as a full fork to address some of the bugs in the fonts. The family consists of: * Libertinus Serif: forked from Linux Libertine. * Libertinus Sans: forked from Linux Biolinum. * Libertinus Mono: forked from Linux Libertine Mono. * Libertinus Math: an OpenType math font for use in OpenType math-capable applications like LuaTEX, XETEX or MS Word 2007+.
